coverage_notes: Only the failed invalidation groups were rerun after the approved test-only repairs; successful parser and focused groups were retained.

Each accepted generated harness contains every expected test function exactly once and returns nonzero on assertions; generation used explicit -skip-running. Counts are distinct test functions, not assertions or total invocations across failed/control attempts.
Existing prealloc-only memory checks remain conditional and were not exercised. test_repeated_component_span_parses_do_not_retain_an_input_sized_copy returns outside prealloc.
GC-specific collection/lifetime checks execute in Boehm. The final helper header supports CUSTOM_DEFINE_gcboehm directly; final accepted native commands use no temporary legacy macro alias.
The lifetime header is absent from the retained parser harnesses, so its subsequent test-only repair does not invalidate their passed results.

Broad generation/native phases used 12 GiB guards and executions used 3 GiB. The retained earlier focused passes used tighter 6 GiB generation, 4 GiB native and 3 GiB execution guards, recorded without rerunning them.
All broad compilation/execution was sequential and occurred after the isolated final performance cohort had completed. No browser runtime source changed during the test compatibility repair.

prior_attempt_summary.reason: Initial generation omitted a cross-test helper; two exact-base dependency files were then added, increasing new coverage from 153 to 162 functions.
Native compilation failed because the original lifetime header required the legacy macro. No tests ran.
Both inherited assertion failures reproduced under Boehm; temporary legacy header macro alias enabled existing lifetime helpers.
The same two inherited assertions failed under no-GC.
Exact original runtime reproduced both Boehm failures with identical test/native flags.
Exact original runtime reproduced both no-GC failures with identical test/native flags.

independent_audit.method: Standalone streaming Cachegrind flat-row parser, SHA256 file checks, Pillow RGBA decode, exact integer acceptance arithmetic; no measurement parser imported and no browser or test rerun.

limitations: This is software-instrumented Cachegrind guest Ir on one frozen, script-free guest DOM fixture; it is not a claim about hardware-retired instructions or native elapsed latency.
The shared Linux sampler-capacity correctness adapter is present in both binaries and receives no optimization credit.

The local Segoe UI font fallbacks and preexisting SVG rendering limitations are identical across accepted captures; pixel equality establishes no regression against this renderer baseline, not equivalence to another browser.
A completed preliminary Callgrind profile was rejected for inconsistent summary/totals and is not included in these counts.
Build/raw-profile receipt paths refer to preserved local evidence; this ledger embeds key counts, hashes, pins and correctness outcomes so the committed result remains reviewable without those files.
CSS FontFace declarations and statuses are audited and decoded pixels match exactly; resolved native font file identities are not pinned.
